notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three members in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Burakos triggers, holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Burakos' ability.
Resolve the copy of Burakos' ability, causing the defending opponent to lose at least three life, and creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasure tokens, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Treasure token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Burakos' ability.
Repeat from step 3.
